newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - RTZ puts bought as stock rallies.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - RTZ puts bought as stock rallies.

text.p: Almost 750 puts were bought on UK mining group RTZ Corp on Thursday as the underlying shares rebounded sharply.
Dealers noted a buyer of 749 February 900 puts at 6p in RTZ options.
The trade will be profitable if the shares, up 19p at 985-1/2p at 1432 GMT, fall by more than 79.5p, or about eight percent.
RTZ shares were buoyed by the strength in copper prices, which climbed to a six-month high at the London Metals Exchange, dealers said.
Options trading was light, partly because Wall Street was closed for a holiday, they said.
Elsewhere, dealers noted scattered activity in options on British Gas, whose shares fell 5-1/2p to 215-1/2p after the company reported its third quarter results.
Volume in British Gas options was about 700 lots as of 1432 GMT, with 595 of them in December 220 puts.

Dealers noted some interest in calls on British Telecommunications as the underlying shares crept to their highest level since mid-September. They were up 3p at 1432 GMT to 380-1/2p, off the day's high of 383p.
About 200 February 360 calls and about 450 February 390 calls traded. Dealers said 200 May 390 straddles were sold.
Some 500 January 120 calls on ASDA Group were sold in what appeared to be a closing order, dealers said. The shares were up 2-1/2p to 119p in active trading.
